notes: Distinct, non-overlapping records: the call path runs. 0x8c10ef64 copies the '+12' string ('hi' in 0x8c200300) into 0x8c200400 padded to 15 bytes and NUL-terminates at +15, leaving r4=dstbuf, r5=15, r6=15, r7=dstbuf+15, r3=0. The post-call copies then set +8=0xdeadbeef, the halfwords 0x8001/0x7fff/0xffff/0x1234 (sign-extended loads, low half stored), +16=0xcafebabe. r1 ends as src+16, r0 as the destination; T=1 is whatever the callee left, since every remaining instruction before rts is flag-neutral. r13/r14 come back from the stack at their entry values.
